name: UpdateExcelRange
label: Update Excel Range (HTTP)
description: Updates values in a specified Excel range using Microsoft Graph HTTP PATCH.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Application (Client) ID of the Azure AD app registered to access Microsoft Graph.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The client secret of the Azure AD application. Ensure it has the necessary permissions (e.g., Files.ReadWrite.All).

fields.name: WorkbookId
fields.label: Workbook ID or DriveItem ID
fields.description: The unique Microsoft Graph ID of the Excel workbook file in OneDrive or SharePoint.

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet within the workbook where the range will be updated (e.g., 'Sheet1').

fields.name: RangeAddress
fields.label: Range Address (e.g., A1:B2)
fields.description: The cell range address in A1-style notation (e.g., 'A1', 'C3:E10') to write data into.

fields.name: ValuesJson
fields.label: Values (JSON or 2D array)
fields.description: A JSON string representing a 2D array of values to write into the range (e.g., [["Apple", 10], ["Banana", 20]]).

fields.name: ResponseJson
fields.label: Response JSON
fields.description: The raw JSON response from Microsoft Graph after updating the range, useful for debugging or advanced scenarios.
